d:
The Congress and Samajwadi Party are facing tough negotiations over seat sharing ahead of the 2027 Uttar Pradesh Assembly elections. Rahul Gandhi has called for a respectful alliance, while Akhilesh Yadav has revealed that Congress submitted a list of 181 seats. With the Samajwadi Party unlikely to agree to such a large share, how many seats will Congress get? Will the INDIA alliance remain united in Uttar Pradesh?
